study.question: Does inverse-norm-rank half-rotation tangent scaling improve full-population validation AUC when the explicit product pairs target category with history brand and target brand with history category? Observed limitation: aligned half beats aligned full by only 0.0001204973276725 AUC (r0012-scale_half 0.6151021885074872 versus r0005-normalized_aligned 0.6149816911798147), after adaptive seed42 selection. Full-gradient crossed unit has AUC0.613391730484387 and Logloss0.1969854236619973, well below full aligned. No crossed half trial is present in the authorized trajectory index. r0028-observer_free_none retains aligned-half scores with mean BCE and unused observers removed. Thus field pairing and backward allocation may interact, or the latter may be generic conditioning. Current proposal exposes model sources and host submission, but no independent-seed invocation; it cannot fulfill the preferred robustness experiment. This is a bounded replacement test, not another magnitude/observer or seed-repeatability study.
study.hypothesis: The inherited half-rotation rule acts partly through generic scale-to-gradient-direction coupling rather than requiring aligned category/brand products. In crossed pairing, replacing the own inverse norm with the stable inverse-norm-rank half-rotation donor will improve AUC over the matched ordinary derivative. Both modes compute the same normalized crossed product at a common state; on nonfloored events the Jacobian is respectively s_donor*(I-u*u^T) or s_own*(I-u*u^T), and on squared norms below1e-6 both retain1000*I. Donors are detached, within the supplied impression, regular and unmasked; no cross-user inputs or labels are used. This predicts a performance direction, not semantic relevance, causality of generalization, or optimality of the surrogate.

study.proposed_difference: Submit exactly two standalone modules: crossed_half (candidate.py, candidate) and crossed_full (crossed_full.py, control). Both use qc*history_brand + qb*history_category, replacing qc*history_category + qb*history_brand, while retaining the same query, summed history and value paths. Candidate uses inherited scale_half_tangent; control uses full. There is no change of loss, train seed, optimizer, capacity or number of exposures. This previously unobserved local combination is a mechanism-distinct forward replacement relative to the selected no-row anchor, but it is built from existing components and carries no verified novelty claim. Validation diagnostics add common-state full/half forward and scale-moment checks and a deterministic artificial float64 VJP oracle. They run only in the authorized host; no local tensor execution or training occurred.
predictions: Primary prospective contrast delta_cross=AUC(crossed_half)-AUC(crossed_full)>0 under the fixed host recipe. Report the signed value regardless of direction. Secondary prediction: Logloss(crossed_half)-Logloss(crossed_full)<=0; disagreement is a ranking/loss tradeoff, not demonstrated calibration.

At a common frozen state, full/half crossed products and logits should agree to floating-point tolerance; masks have zero attention mass, empty summaries vanish and logits remain finite. Candidate-authored audits on512 examples do not certify population or training-wide equivalence.

Half allocation should conserve the first/second moments of eligible scalar inverse norms per impression; synthetic hand donors and full/half VJPs should match the independent analytical formula. This does not conserve accumulated parameter gradients or Adam update energy.

Changing full crossed to the observer-free shared body may reproduce r0005-crossed_unit metrics; this is a diagnostic expectation, not an assumed bridge. Historical aligned-minus-crossed or difference-in-differences values remain descriptive even if aggregate scores match, because round5 source and matched independent seeds are not exposed.

Parameters and training data passes should match within the pair. Sorting/gradient work can change measured cost: report host train/wall/peak memory and whole-batch inference p50/p95/throughput, without a causal speedup or equal-compute claim. All inherited full-population slices retain host bins/counts and exploratory status.
falsifiers: delta_cross<=0 fails the directional transfer prediction for this implementation/seed. A favorable aligned contrast and null/negative crossed contrast would weaken a pairing-independent explanation but would not establish alignment necessity or universally refute half allocation.

Any undeclared source/config/initialization/loss/data/scorer difference within the two new modules invalidates the isolated backward comparison. Nonfinite logits, mask/empty-history failures or synthetic derivative/donor failure suspend mechanism attribution and retain all costs/failed receipts.

Same-state full/half forward discrepancies above1e-6 on the bounded sample, synthetic float64 relative VJP error above1e-9 or donor indices differing from the hand table invalidate the declared implementation until diagnosed; no favorable validation score overrides a failed integrity check.

Crossed_full metrics differing from historical r0005-crossed_unit defeat an exact aggregate replay bridge. Do not repair historical metrics or use this mismatch to refute a scientific mechanism; prohibit treating the mixed-round four-cell interaction as confirmatory.

In future prospectively paired seeds, nonpositive mean delta_cross or reversals in both43/44 weaken robustness. These seeds are a target conditional on a later authorized interface, not executable jobs in this proposal. A single result supplies no significance, bootstrap interval or repeated mechanism support.
alternative_explanations: Seed42/checkpoint fluctuations and adaptive validation reuse can dominate the small historical half effect. Current fixed-seed interface cannot resolve initialization uncertainty or erase prior selection bias.

Generic optimization/regularization, changed scale-to-direction coupling, gradient accumulation or Adam moments can cause changes without semantic matching. Scalar scale-moment conservation does not match full gradient norms/updates.

Crossed products preserve two terms and unit norm but change coordinate statistics, nonfloored directions, norms before normalization, sort ties and donor ordering. Other query/history/value blocks retain field information, and embeddings can learn compensating representations; crossed is not an information-null or meaning-destruction control.

Same-seed aggregate/slice equality can conceal per-example or optimizer-state differences. Historical source path/default/operation-order effects remain unresolved without the missing round5 source/checkpoint artifacts.

Shared representation learning can change empty-history results even when empty summaries vanish; these changes cannot directly demonstrate event retrieval. First512 ordered diagnostics and overlapping slices are not a representative semantic mechanism test.

Host load, caching, scheduling and sorting overhead can change timings. Training passes and parameter matching isolate a declared learning-rule contrast but do not establish matched compute or a quality-cost frontier.

The initially supplied candidate.py implements older magnitude surgery, whereas this study intentionally branches from existing no-row observer-free r0028. Preserve both lineage and the historical maximum; no failed magnitude result is erased or generalized to all magnitude methods.
